transcript.text: Hello, this is the scheduling assistant for Riverside Family Clinic. How can I help you today?
I'd like an appointment, I'm new.
Welcome. May I have your full name and date of birth?
Thanks, Ethan. What insurance provider do you have?
No problem, I've noted no insurance. Dr. Smith has Monday at 10 AM or Wednesday at 2 PM.
Booked: Ethan Park, Monday at 10 AM. A confirmation will be sent. Goodbye.
